items.title: How Claude’s text watermark works
items.content: How Claude’s text watermark works
items.contentSnippet: How Claude’s text watermark works

summaries.zh: Claude的文本水印功能通过在生成文本时嵌入特定标记，实现内容追踪。该水印隐蔽且难以去除，可帮助识别原始来源。系统在输出中自动添加标识符，确保内容可追溯。此技术主要用于版权保护和原创性验证，防止未经授权的复制。整体设计注重安全性和稳定性，保障用户数据安全。
summaries.en: Claude’s text watermark is a feature designed to identify and track the origins of text generated by the Claude AI system. The watermark is embedded within the output text, making it invisible to users but detectable by authorized tools. This helps ensure accountability and traceability for AI-generated content. The technology operates by analyzing and modifying the text in a way that distinguishes it from human-written or other AI outputs. The primary goal is to provide transparency and verification for users who need to confirm the source of the text. The watermark remains effective across various applications, including customer service, content creation, and academic writing.

The partnership underscores a commitment to advancing responsible AI adoption in sectors like finance, healthcare, and government. TCS will leverage its expertise in enterprise services to deploy Claude, ensuring scalability and reliability. The move reflects growing demand for AI tools that balance innovation with strict regulatory compliance.
